name: wait_for_work
title: Wait for work
description: Wait for the next request from godspeed (a lesson turn, a Talk message, a background job, or a knowledge-graph run). Returns a work item, or status "idle" if nothing arrived in time — then call again.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait in seconds (default 45, at most 600). Stay under your client's tool timeout: for Codex that is its tool_timeout_sec (60 unless raised; the godspeed folder's start command sets 620).

lesson_id.description: Stay on this lesson: take its turns and Talk messages, plus background jobs (file reading, graph building, research) while no helper is open, so they never get stuck. Other lessons wait.

full_context.description: Send the whole conversation and instructions again, even if you saw them before (use after losing your context).

helper.description: Send true on every call when you are the helper: a second session beside the teacher, started when the user says "Start as the helper". A helper takes the background jobs (file reading, graph building, sheets), and lesson or Talk turns only while the teacher tidies its memory.

name: respond
title: Respond to work
description: Answer a work item the way a model would: text for the learner (or the task), and/or calls to the tools listed in the work item. Returns the next work item in the same conversation when the app needs you again right away (for example with tool results), or status "turn_complete".

work_id.description: The workId from wait_for_work or a previous respond.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls, run in order. Use only tools listed in the work item.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the follow-up (default 30).

name: read_work
title: Read more of a work item
description: Read one page of a long work item, or (full: true) get the item again in full: its instructions, every tool and the whole conversation, for when you lost track of it. When a work item says it has several pages, read all of them before you respond.

work_id.description: The workId of the work item.

full.description: Send the whole item again instead of one page (after your context was compacted, or when you no longer have the instructions or tools it refers to).

name: list_lessons
title: List lessons
description: List the learner's lessons, newest first, each with its space and kind (study or homework; older ones teach or practice). total says how many match.

space_id.description: Only the lessons of this space (from list_spaces), or "none" for lessons without a space. Leave it out for all lessons.

name: read_lesson
title: Read a lesson
description: Read one lesson as markdown: everything the teacher and learner said, quizzes and answers included. A long lesson comes in pages; each page says which page it is and how many there are.

name: search_graph
title: Search the knowledge graph
description: Search one space's knowledge graph (each space has its own): the facts (propositions) the learner has learned and the reasoning chains connecting them. Without a query, returns the most recent facts.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words (matched by meaning and by keywords).

space_id.description: The space id from list_spaces, or "none" for lessons without a space (the default).

name: import_notes
title: Import notes
description: Add notes to a knowledge graph. godspeed turns them into facts in the background; that work arrives through wait_for_work. Returns right away. With space_id the notes become a study file of that space (to add a file from disk, use add_space_file).

name.description: A file-like name for the notes, e.g. "biology-ch3.md". In a space, re-importing the same name replaces that file and rebuilds its facts; in No space it is processed again and adds to that import.

space_id.description: The space id from list_spaces, or "none" for lessons without a space (the default).

name: remember
title: Remember a note
description: Save a short note about the learner. Every agent that connects to godspeed later sees it under "Where you left off", in any folder. Save what the learner tells you outside lessons that will matter next time: an exam that is over, what they plan to study next, how they like to learn. One fact per note, at most 200 characters. Never save passwords or private details. The learner can see and delete notes in Settings → Connection.

space_id.description: The space the note is about, if one (from list_spaces).

name: forget
title: Forget a note
description: Delete a saved note by its note_id (from "Where you left off" or from remember). Use it when a note is out of date or the learner asks.

name: save_rule
title: Save a teaching rule
description: Save a rule about how godspeed's teacher teaches this learner, when they tell you a lasting preference ("use Python for code examples", "shorter answers"). It joins the learner's rules in Settings, for every lesson or for one space's lessons, and applies from the next turn. Not for one-off requests or facts about the learner (use remember for those). Don't ask first: the godspeed window shows it with Undo and Edit.

rule.description: One line, an instruction to the teacher, e.g. "Use Python for code examples."

space_id.description: Only for this space's lessons (from list_spaces). Leave it out for every lesson.

area.description: For every lesson, the part of teaching it is about: "voice", "teaching" (the default), "questions", "facts", "demos" or "files" (files, formatting and code).

name: list_spaces
title: List spaces
description: List the learner's spaces, archived ones included, with file and lesson counts.

name: read_space
title: Read a space
description: Read one space: its description, how many files are in each status (pending, extracting, ready, failed, needs-whisper) and the files that could not be read, the topics of its knowledge graph with their fact counts, its deadlines (kind, date, time, done, and the files each covers), its lessons, and today's local date and time. A prep (a space made to get ready for one interview, assessment or test) also has its prep sheet: what the learner is preparing for, its day, what it is like, the topics with their ids and how each is going, what a mock is and the mocks taken. With files: true it lists every file instead (id, kind, status, size, path on disk). To find something inside the files, use search_space_files.

files.description: List every file with its id (needed for file_ids). Default false.

name: search_space_files
title: Search a space's files
description: Search all of a space's files (readings, slides, transcripts, syllabus, assignments) by meaning and keywords. Returns the best passages, each with its id, file, place (page, slide, time or lines) and a short snippet. Open the ones you need with read_passage instead of reading whole files.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

name: read_passage
title: Read a passage of a space file
description: Read one passage of a space file by its id from search_space_files, or a file's passages at a place (file_id + range, e.g. a whole page). Returns the text with the ids of the passages before and after it, to keep reading.

passage_id.description: A passage id from search_space_files (or a previous/next id).

file_id.description: Instead of passage_id: a file id from read_space, with range.

range.description: With file_id: the place, e.g. "p. 12", "slide 4", "section 3", "12:30" or "lines 40".

name: create_space
title: Create a space
description: Create a space for one thing the learner is studying (a university course, a certification, a language). The description is shown to the teacher in every lesson of the space: level, the book or source they follow, its notation, what they are working toward (a course's exams, an interview). Add the space's deadlines with add_space_deadline.

name.description: The space's name, e.g. "MATH 20C – Calculus III" or "Conversational Spanish".

description.description: What the teacher should know about the space, in the learner's terms.

signature.description: The space's signature: ONE line that sums up the subject, shown huge on the space's cover. kind "math" = LaTeX without $ (math, physics, chemistry, economics), "code" = a line of code (programming spaces), "text" = anything else (a line from a primary source, a sequence, a date). At most 60 characters. Pick something iconic for the subject; ask the learner when unsure.

icon.description: The space's subject icon in the space switcher: "cpu" Computer science, "code" Programming, "sigma" Math, "chart-line" Statistics, "atom" Physics, "flask-conical" Chemistry, "dna" Biology, "brain" Psychology, "landmark" History, "scale" Law and politics, "trending-up" Economics, "globe" Geography, "languages" Languages, "book-open" Literature, "palette" Art, "music" Music. Pick the closest subject.

name: update_space
title: Update a space
description: Rename a space, change its description, signature or icon, or archive / unarchive it (archiving hides it from the space switcher but keeps everything; an archived space takes no new lessons).

signature.description: The space's signature: ONE line that sums up the subject, shown huge on the space's cover. kind "math" = LaTeX without $ (math, physics, chemistry, economics), "code" = a line of code (programming spaces), "text" = anything else (a line from a primary source, a sequence, a date). At most 60 characters. Pick something iconic for the subject; ask the learner when unsure.

icon.description: The space's subject icon in the space switcher: "cpu" Computer science, "code" Programming, "sigma" Math, "chart-line" Statistics, "atom" Physics, "flask-conical" Chemistry, "dna" Biology, "brain" Psychology, "landmark" History, "scale" Law and politics, "trending-up" Economics, "globe" Geography, "languages" Languages, "book-open" Literature, "palette" Art, "music" Music. Pick the closest subject.

name: add_space_file
title: Add a file to a space
description: Copy a file from this computer into a space. Supported: .md .txt, code files (.c .py .java .js and the like), plain text with no extension, .pdf .docx .pptx .epub, .vtt .srt (transcripts) and .mp3 .m4a .wav .mp4 .mov (recordings, transcribed locally with whisper.cpp). Google Docs links (.gdoc) need saving as PDF or Word first. Study files are turned into facts by you, through wait_for_work.

kind.description: "study" = study material turned into graph facts (notes, readings, transcripts, recordings); "info" = space info the teacher can read but that never becomes facts (a syllabus, a schedule, logistics).

name: set_space_file_kind
title: Set space files' kind
description: Switch one or more space files between study material and space info. Study → info removes their facts; info → study builds them. A file that can't be switched is listed under refused; the others still switch.

file_ids.description: The files to switch (ids from read_space with files: true).

kind.description: "study" = study material turned into graph facts (notes, readings, transcripts, recordings); "info" = space info the teacher can read but that never becomes facts (a syllabus, a schedule, logistics).

name: add_space_deadline
title: Add deadlines to a space
description: Add one or more deadlines to a space (send all of a space's deadlines in one call): exams, homework, quizzes and projects, each with its date, its time if it has one, and which of the space's files (notes, readings) it covers. godspeed uses this to show the learner what is due and what to work on first. Take the deadlines, their dates and times from the space info files (a syllabus, a schedule), and never make up a date or time. Work out what a deadline covers from the space's own files first: a practice exam or review sheet, the schedule, announcements (search_space_files). Link the files they point to (file_ids), list files from before it that it doesn't cover in left_out_ids, and say in source which file it came from. Ask only when the files don't settle it. File ids come from read_space with files: true. A deadline that is refused is listed under refused with the reason; the others are still added, so send only the refused ones again.

time.description: The due time as 24-hour "HH:MM" on this computer's clock. Leave it out when there is none (it then counts as due at the end of the day).

file_ids.description: Ids of the space files it covers.

left_out_ids.description: Ids of space files from before it that it does NOT cover (e.g. lectures after the practice exam's last topic). The learner's page stops flagging them as missing.

source.description: Where you found what it covers, e.g. the practice exam's file name. The learner sees it.

assignment_file_id.description: For homework and projects: the id of the space file with its problems (the assignment sheet). The learner works on its problems in godspeed.

name: update_space_deadline
title: Update a space deadline
description: Change a deadline's kind, name, date, time, covered files, left-out files, source or assignment file, or tick it done (done: true) or not done (done: false). file_ids and left_out_ids each replace the whole list (a file is never in both); time: null, source: null and assignment_file_id: null remove them. Work out coverage from the space's own files as add_space_deadline says; ask the learner when the files don't settle it.

time.description: 24-hour "HH:MM", or null to remove the time.

file_ids.description: Ids of the space files it covers.

left_out_ids.description: Ids of space files from before it that it does NOT cover (e.g. lectures after the practice exam's last topic). The learner's page stops flagging them as missing.

source.description: Where you found what it covers, e.g. the practice exam's file name. The learner sees it.

assignment_file_id.description: For homework and projects: the id of the space file with its problems (the assignment sheet). The learner works on its problems in godspeed.

name: remove_space_deadline
title: Remove a space deadline
description: Remove one deadline from a space (its files and facts are not touched).

name: link_space_folder
title: Link a folder to a space
description: Link a folder on this computer to a space. Its supported files are added, and from then on new files dropped there are added automatically and edited files are rebuilt (checked every minute while godspeed is open). godspeed sorts them into study material and space info itself while reading them, and never changes the folder. Use set_space_file_kind only to correct a kind.

name: update_prep
title: Change a prep sheet
description: Change a prep's sheet when the learner asks (read_space shows it): move or clear its day, replace what it is like, change what a mock is, add topics, or remove topics by id. Only what you send changes. Refused while the sheet is being written.

date.description: The day it happens as YYYY-MM-DD, or null for no day.

about.description: What it is like, in markdown. Replaces the whole text.

mock.description: What one mock is: how many questions in how many minutes.

add_topics.description: Topics to add at the end of the sheet, each with one line on why it is there.

remove_topic_ids.description: Ids of the sheet's topics to remove.

name: start_lesson
title: Start a lesson
description: Start a new study session in godspeed taught by you: you teach what is new and give problems on what needs practice. The topic becomes the learner's first message. With space_id the lesson belongs to that space: it opens with the space's card and its facts go into that space's graph. In a prep, a topic named exactly like one on its sheet counts for that topic. You teach it through wait_for_work; the learner follows along in the godspeed window.

topic.description: What the learner wants to study, in their words.

space_id.description: The space id from list_spaces, or "none" for lessons without a space (the default).

name: unlink_space_folder
title: Unlink a space's folder
description: Unlink the space's folder: its files leave the space together with their facts. The folder itself is not touched.
